law.catch_line: Card system record and index of delinquent real estate in City of Norfolk
law.text: The City of Norfolk is authorized to keep its record of delinquent real estate and all liens described under § 58.1-3745 in the Treasurer's office, using a card system record and index, or such other method approved by the Auditor of Public Accounts.
